app.chooseFolderToKeep: Choose the folder to keep in sync with {what}

app.dockerIsntReachableNothing: Docker isn't reachable, so there is nothing to show yet. Start Docker, or set a sandbox up from your workspace.
app.gettingComputerReadyStarting: We're getting this computer ready and starting your sandbox. It usually takes a few minutes, and your workspace opens by itself when it's done.

app.nothingOnComputerChanges: Nothing on this computer changes until you say so.
app.pickingUpWhereRestart: Picking up where the restart left off. Nothing needs doing: this window carries on by itself.
app.runningOnDeviceKeeps: Running on this device: it keeps going even if you close this window.

app.sandboxRunsInDocker2: Your sandbox runs in Docker, which isn't running yet. Setup installs it first, so your system asks for your password once.
app.saysPairingAlreadyUsed: If it says the pairing was already used or expired, regenerate it in your workspace.
app.setupCodeRanOut: Your setup code ran out while this device was away. Everything the restart was for is already done; it just needs a fresh code to carry on.
app.stoppedInstallNothingElse: You stopped this install. Nothing else is running on this device.

docker.accountNotAllowed: This account isn't allowed to use Docker
docker.accountNotAllowedWindows: This Windows account isn't allowed to use Docker yet
docker.addToDockerGroup: Add your user to the docker group, then check again.

docker.tryOpeningItYourself: Try opening it yourself, then check again.
